They preserve the existing default: never send `defaultValue` for them. Include group/description on that same widget edit rather than creating a second incomplete widget edit. `insertLiteralParameter` additionally requires a typed `defaultValue`. `moveGroup` accepts only `kind,name,group`; `hideParameter` accepts only `kind,name`.
